_comment: ScraperFactory member name -> Hebrew market_name stored in market_prices.market_name. Shared by scraper/chain_map.py and scripts/sync_scraped_prices.js so there's one source of truth. Where a chain is already seeded (see CHAIN_STORES in src/app/api/shopping/compare/route.ts), the name matches exactly so new rows land under existing names. Chains not yet in CHAIN_STORES will be skipped by geolocation filtering there until a branch location is added — a follow-up, not a bug here.
